goal: Coordinate multiple independent Codex task runners for a safely parallelizable AgentPlane goal.

task_template.title: Coordinate parallel Codex runner tasks
task_template.description: Split the approved parent goal into independent child tasks, launch each through the Codex runner, monitor runner status/logs, and summarize integration order and blockers.

doc.summary: Use AgentPlane runner observability to coordinate several independent Codex task runners.
doc.scope: Only create child tasks when file ownership, lifecycle authority, and verification boundaries are explicit and non-overlapping.
doc.plan: Classify candidate work slices, reject conflicting slices, create approved child tasks, launch each with `agentplane task run`, monitor with `status`, `inspect`, and `logs`, then integrate only after all child results are verified.
doc.verify_steps: For every child task, record task id, run id, status command output, inspected recent events, log tail, result manifest status, and remaining integration blocker if any.
doc.rollback_plan: Stop launching new child runners, mark blocked child tasks with their conflict path set, and integrate only already verified non-conflicting work.

parent_goal.description: The approved parent goal to split into child runner tasks.

candidate_slices.description: Proposed independent work slices with expected outputs.

conflict_boundaries.description: Files, task lifecycle actions, or shared resources each child must avoid unless explicitly assigned.

child_task_ids.description: Child AgentPlane task ids created for independent runner execution.

runner_run_ids.description: Runner run ids returned by `agentplane task run` or discovered by `task run status`.

monitoring_commands.description: Exact status, inspect, and logs commands used to monitor each child.

integration_order.description: Safe order for reviewing, integrating, or blocking child outputs.

steps.summary: Separate parent work into child slices with explicit owned paths, expected evidence, and stop rules.
Do not parallelize slices that share write paths, lifecycle authority, release/publish actions, or unresolved policy decisions.
Create one AgentPlane task per safe slice; include owned paths, forbidden paths, verification commands, and required result manifest fields.
Run `agentplane task run <task-id>` for each child and record run ids from status output.
Use `agentplane task run status`, `inspect --events`, and `logs --stream events --follow` to track every running child.
Verify child results, block conflicting children, and integrate only outputs with clean evidence and non-overlapping diffs.
